title: SG-1.4.2 · Render HeaderOverlay from App through the GameLayout header slot
summary: App shows HeaderOverlay via a GameLayout header slot, with real round loading and error state, and the old RoundBadge and Countdown are gone from App.
description: Context: App.tsx currently renders RoundBadge and Countdown directly inside the scene and silently swallows getCurrentRound failures with .catch(() => setRound(undefined)). HeaderOverlay already exists with loading, error and empty states, but nothing renders it, and GameLayout has no header slot. Desired behavior: GameLayout takes an optional header prop shown as a compact overlay in the game area. App passes HeaderOverlay into it with the round, loading and error state from the existing round fetch. Expected result: the header explains round API failures, and no standalone badge or countdown remains. Why: the redesign requires a compact header overlay with proper loading, empty and error states.
acceptance_criteria: Given GameLayout receives a header prop, when it renders, then the header node appears inside the main game area
Given the round fetch is pending, when App is in the playing view, then the header shows 'Loading round…'
Given getCurrentRound rejects, when App is in the playing view, then the header shows an alert containing the failure message
Given the playing view, when App renders, then no standalone RoundBadge or Countdown is rendered outside HeaderOverlay

in_scope: App wiring of HeaderOverlay and round loading/error state
Removing RoundBadge and Countdown usage from App
out_of_scope: Deleting the RoundBadge or Countdown component files (Countdown is still used by HeaderOverlay)
preserve: GameLayout 80/20 grid and mobile drawer behavior

technical_constraints: React + TypeScript + Vite, Tailwind classes, Zustand useUiStore
Use the existing getCurrentRound from src/api/client.ts; no mock data in product code
definition_of_done: All three requirements implemented and their unit tests pass
